visual_name: Day in the life, part twelve: the hashtag hour (low-poly 3D)
code_name: three.js diner at night with flickering neon, box-built character, pancakes that frost over, guru cards / Hashtag Research results, a caption box of tag chips, hard cuts on voiceover word times
summary: A 39 second 9:16 reel in low-poly 3D: a ten-minute video and an hour of hashtags, three gurus with three answers, FYP typed four ways with one banned, pancakes gone cold; then YourBrand's Hashtag Research: type the niche, fifteen tags in broad, niche and micro buckets with reasons, the campaign's tags on top, Copy all. This time he eats the pancakes.
